source: Translate the predeclared G0_CASES stress_constructs; no data-selected parents

C1.intended: high relative and absolute information; concentrated finite posterior

C2.intended: high relative retention but weak absolute information

C3.intended: weak material information and small declared-task change
C3.future_task: same single port at fixed declared target

C4.intended: weak joint material information but larger future-task propagation change
C4.future_task: 25 fixed prior poses, max whitened complete 2TX/16RX response difference

independent_units: 9 distinct physical parent worlds; C2/C3 are a matched observation-contract comparison, not six independent worlds
rank_error: Per fixture spectral norm of fixed-vs-interface-fitted real-whitened full seven-column Jacobian difference after declared scaling. EMPIRICAL, no uniform or continuum claim.
gaussian_diagnostic: Identity precision in standardized coordinates. Proper tangent Gaussian only, not the boxed physical prior or exact non-Gaussian posterior.

bounded_finite_prior.identity: BGGA_G0_LOCAL_FINITE15_V1; conditional known-support mechanism fixture, NOT unknown-support inference
bounded_finite_prior.wall_nodes: center weight1/3; four (eps +/-.1, ell +/-.01) corners each weight1/6
bounded_finite_prior.noise: same full64 real Gaussian draw per physical parent, seed=27102700+physical_parent_index; C2/C3 share draw

finite_pair.pose_corrector: One frozen pose-Jacobian ordinary least-squares proposal plus at most two same-Jacobian corrections; only declared current-port residual determines accepted best feasible endpoint
finite_pair.boundaries: clip proposal pose to existing legal box; total material must remain legal; no truth-based endpoint selection

future25: Sorted cos(pi*i/4) x; y=2.1+.5*sorted cos(pi*i/4), radius.12 contrast3 ell.02; all25 evaluated, never select best probe from data
future_verification: Pair endpoints for every selected fixed probe; independent interface-fitted check of argmax for each C4 fixture; empirical margin only
budget_closeout: If90% reached while this predeclared job is active, only already-declared endpoint/independent verification closes out; no new campaign
class_assignment: Measured results may contradict intended class; retain missing/undefined classes without redesign
